subject: organic
question: 有机化学·Reaction Learn 命名反应学习卡：请用文字概述该反应的主要转化：Conia-ene reaction。 来源卡片给出的代表性条件：Ph₃PAuCl, AgOTf (1 mol%), CH₂Cl₂, rt。
answer: The enol of a carbonyl compound adds intramolecularly to an alkene or alkyne and closes a ring: an intramolecular ene reaction.
explanation: 来源补充说明（未专家审核）：Thermally it needs about 350 °C; β-keto esters with gold(I) or other Lewis acid catalysts react at room temperature. A terminal alkyne cyclises 5-exo, giving an exocyclic alkene.
